description:
UI Focused role. 

 Top Three Skills: 

   1) 5+ years in Javascript 
 2) Experience creting unit tests with Karma, Mocha or Chai 
 3) Experience with Angular Framework  
 Job Description: 
 SunPower is looking for a Javascript/UI Developer to join the existing development team in Austin. The developer will be working on a portal that allows customers to see their solar usage, energy saving, environmental savings, etc.  
 The team need someone with the following skills. 

 • 5+ years’ experience writing JavaScript
 • 2+ years’ experience HTML/CSS UI development skills
 • Attention to detail
 • JavaScript unit test experience is plus
 • Experience with Angular is bonus 
 Additional Information: 
 Work Environment: 

 SunPower very laid back environment and the dress code for work is casual. The team has the option to work remote if necessary.  

 EVP: 
 http://rws.allegisgroup.com/RWS/images/callout_question.gif
 This is a great opportunity for a developer to get experience with the Angular framework which is becoming very popular. The solar power industry is a very exciting industry to be a part of right now. 
 Non-Technical Skills: 
 Good communication skills and easy to work with.  

 Technical Environment: 
 Javascript, Angular.JS, PhoneGap, Agile  



 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 6 months
